title.hi: उपादान और निमित्त कारण: घड़ा कौन बनाता है?
title.en: Material and Efficient Cause: Who Really Makes the Pot?

inline.jpg.en: An elderly village potter seated at his wheel under a tiled roof, with rows of many finished clay pots in front of him

-MdwHudA9q0.jpg.en: Video: "Who Really Creates Your Life? The Two Causes You Must Know", Acharya Upendra Ji in a white kurta against a starry sky, with the words "You're Doing Everything... But Something's Missing!"

hi.meta_description: उपादान और निमित्त कारण क्या हैं? कुम्हार और घड़े के उदाहरण से आचार्य उपेंद्र जी समझाते हैं कि "मैंने बनाया" कहने वाला अहंकार असली कर्ता क्यों नहीं है।

en.focus_keyword: material and efficient cause in Vedanta
en.meta_description: What are the material and efficient causes in Vedanta? With a potter and his pot, Acharya Upendra Ji shows why the "I made it" ego is not the true doer.
